label: THE PROBLEM
title: Check what your prompt leaves unsaid.
detail: Missing context. Unclear constraints. No definition of done.

label: A FAMILIAR REQUEST
title: “Make it better.”
detail: Better how? What must stay the same?

label: MEET PCP
title: Governance before the model.
detail: Prompt Control Plane is a deterministic prompt governance engine.

label: ONE ENGINE
title: Local checks. Shared rules.
detail: Scoring, routing and analysis run locally. Zero model calls inside the engine.

label: THE WORKFLOW
title: Inspect. Refine. Then proceed.
detail: Score the structure, classify the task and inspect the recommendation. Add context and constraints.
items: Same input + rules + configuration = same result
You still review the model’s answer

label: TWO STARTING POINTS
title: preflight + optimize
detail: Check the request. Prepare a clearer version.

label: PREFLIGHT
title: Read the result before sending.
detail: Task, risk, model recommendation and input quality in one call.
items: Actual cost depends on workload and usage

label: OPTIMIZE
title: Make the goal and constraints explicit.
detail: Authentication bug: find the root cause, preserve compatibility and add a regression test.

label: TEAM WORKFLOWS
title: Bring checks into everyday work.
detail: Review prompts alongside the code that uses them.

label: GITHUB ACTION
title: A repeatable pull request check.
detail: Check prompt files, configure a threshold and publish feedback alongside code review.

label: VALIDATE API
title: Your application decides the next step.
detail: Pass a prompt and threshold. Inspect the result, then return feedback or block the next step.
items: Same deterministic scoring engine as the CLI

label: CHOOSE YOUR SURFACE
title: Fit the check to your workflow.
detail: Use the same engine where your team already works.

label: MCP CLIENT
title: Connect your assistant to PCP.
detail: Add the server to your MCP configuration. Compatible assistants can use analysis, compilation and governance tools.

label: TERMINAL
title: Install. Check. Refine.
detail: Read the feedback, fill the gaps and run the check again. Supported hooks can bring checks into editing.
code:
npm install -g pcp-engine

pcp preflight "Review auth module security" --json

label: APPLICATION API
title: Put the check inside your application.
detail: Import the function, pass a request and inspect the result. Your code decides what happens next.
code:
import { validate } from 'pcp-engine/validate';

const { pass, score, issues } = validate(prompt);

label: THE PRINCIPLE
title: Repeatable checks before generation.
detail: Zero model calls inside the engine. Terminal commands and assistant integrations.

label: GET STARTED
title: Start with a prompt you use every day.
detail: Run preflight. Read the feedback. Fill the gaps.
